tips.text: Start the Akstiletto research first; it is a 72-hour timer, and Zakti's own 72-hour timer follows it.
Join a clan with an established Tenno Lab; the research is paid by clan contributions.
Farm Oxium and Salvage together on Io while the two research timers run.
Oxium is the only slow part; Control Modules are quick if you know where to look.
